name: faceabot
description: Search engine for AI agents: describe a need, get the MCP tool that actually works for it, with measured reliability, limits and fallbacks. Remote server, free, no key.
suggestedPrompts: Use Faceabot to find a working MCP tool for a weather forecast in Brussels
Ask Faceabot which MCP server can turn a PDF into Markdown, and how reliable it is
Ask Faceabot for the next TEC bus from Braine-l'Alleud to Waterloo
